title: EONAPP coherent product program
sourceTruth: This ledger tracks source-ready work and explicit evidence gaps. It does not certify a Cloudflare deployment, browser/device result, OAuth consent flow, merchant approval, payment, subscription, user-data recovery, provider connection or paid entitlement.

productArchitecture.navigationDecision: Insights & Forecasts is an Apps collection with a direct compatibility route, not a new top-level flagship nav item.

globalReleaseBlocks: No external W276 update/rollback/restore evidence has been collected.
No combined Cloudflare Preview, browser, device or installed-PWA proof exists for the current W375 baseline.
No payment processor merchant account, test-mode checkout, webhook, entitlement, refund or support proof is active.
No licensed financial-data contract, attribution, freshness policy or regional policy is active.
No live provider integration or OAuth consent proof is active.
No provider has explicitly accepted in writing the current EONAPP catalogue, India payout route or EON Invite promotion; no merchant selection is final.

lanes.title: Merchant and entitlement architecture decision
lanes.next: Keep provider unselected. Obtain written acceptance for the narrow productivity-Pack catalogue, India/global payout path and EON Invite promotion; then prove a hosted test-mode one-time Pack, signed webhook, idempotent entitlement, refund/dispute reversal and licence revocation.

lanes.title: Single one-time official Pack test-mode proof
lanes.next: Run one processor test-mode collection, verified webhook, idempotent grant, refund reversal and support receipt flow. No production charge is allowed in this lane.

lanes.title: Subscription pilot decision
lanes.next: Do not introduce recurring billing until one-time Pack lifecycle proof, W276 recovery proof and repeat Pack-use evidence exist. The future solo ladder is Plus, Studio, Power and Max only; Team/Scale/Enterprise are out of the current roadmap.
